feature: FILM-1904 MCP endpoint, personal access tokens and request auth

mutations.name: MCP U1 membership is no longer re-checked per call
MCP U2 a revoked token verifies
MCP U3 the rate limit decision is ignored
MCP U4 a tool runs without its scope
MCP U5 another team's slug is accepted
MCP U6 a crash's message reaches the client
mutations.pattern: a crash is INTERNAL without them

mutations.name: MCP U7 the Authorization header is logged as sent
MCP U8 the caller can choose the generation mode
mutations.replace: return storage.run({ mode: 'external', ...context } as McpRequestContext, fn);

mutations.name: MCP U9 the web app imports the developer MCP server
MCP U10 a tool handler reaches for the service role
mutations.replace:
import { McpToolError } from '../../errors';
import { getSupabaseServerAdminClient } from '@kit/supabase/server-admin-client';

mutations.name: MCP U11 incr is no longer atomic on redis
mutations.pattern: INCR and EXPIRE as one script

mutations.name: MCP DB1 every signed-in user reads every connection
mutations.sql: drop policy mcp_connections_read on public.mcp_connections; create policy mcp_connections_read on public.mcp_connections for select to authenticated using (true);

mutations.name: MCP DB2 a user may rewrite a connection's name and scopes
mutations.sql: grant update on public.mcp_connections to authenticated;

mutations.name: MCP DB3 token hashes are readable by signed-in users
mutations.sql: grant select on public.mcp_tokens to authenticated;

mutations.name: MCP DB4 every member reads the team's tool calls
mutations.sql: drop policy mcp_tool_calls_read on public.mcp_tool_calls; create policy mcp_tool_calls_read on public.mcp_tool_calls for select to authenticated using (public.has_role_on_account(account_id));

mutations.name: MCP DB6 a connection is bound to a personal account
mutations.sql: drop trigger require_team_account on public.mcp_connections; drop trigger require_team_account on public.mcp_tool_calls;

mutations.name: MCP DB5 a token for another team is created
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.create_mcp_personal_access_token(p_account_id uuid, p_name text, p_scopes text[], p_token_hash text) returns public.mcp_connections language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$ declare v public.mcp_connections; begin insert into public.mcp_connections (user_id, account_id, kind, name, scopes) values ((select auth.uid()), p_account_id, 'pat', p_name, p_scopes) returning * into v; insert into public.mcp_tokens (token_hash, connection_id, kind) values (p_token_hash, v.id, 'pat'); return v; end $$;
